GUMAnimations.Settings.enabled.Name: Enable GUM Animations
GUMAnimations.Settings.enabled.Hint: Routes public GUM events to the first available animation adapter.
GUMAnimations.Settings.playOnFailure.Hin: Allows failed rolls to reach the visual adapter, which may render them as misses.
GUMAnimations.Settings.debug.Name: Console diagnostics
GUMAnimations.Settings.debug.Hint: Logs which adapter handled each event and the received contexts.
GUMAnimations.Errors.IncompatibleApi: GUM Animations requires GUM public API {version} or newer.
